{
  "cases": [
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-001",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Admin user can sign in with correct credentials",
      "coverage_area": "valid login",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "admin@testmu.local",
        "password": "{{admin_password}}"
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into login-email",
        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into login-password",
        "Click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 response redirecting to /dashboard",
        "Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session",
        "Dashboard displays role admin in element user-role"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-002",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Login trims spaces and lower‑cases email",
      "coverage_area": "valid login",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "  ADMIN@TESTMU.LOCAL  ",
        "password": "{{admin_password}}"
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email \"  ADMIN@TESTMU.LOCAL  \" into login-email",
        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into login-password",
        "Click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 response redirecting to /dashboard",
        "Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session",
        "Dashboard displays role admin in element user-role",
        "Email is trimmed and lower‑cased before lookup, resulting in successful sign‑in"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-003",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Sign‑in fails with wrong password for existing user",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "viewer@testmu.local",
        "password": "wrongpass"
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local into login-email",
        "Enter password wrongpass into login-password",
        "Click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 401 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Invalid email or password.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-004",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Sign‑in with unknown email returns generic error",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "unknown@example.com",
        "password": "anyPassword"
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email unknown@example.com into login-email",
        "Enter password anyPassword into login-password",
        "Click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 401 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Invalid email or password.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-005",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Sign‑in with empty email and password shows invalid credentials error",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "",
        "password": ""
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Leave login-email empty",
        "Leave login-password empty",
        "Click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 401 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Invalid email or password.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-006",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Forgot password for existing account sends reset email",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "viewer@testmu.local"
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local into forgot-email",
        "Click forgot-submit",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=viewer@testmu.local"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "Element forgot-confirmation contains text \"If an account exists for that email, we've sent a password reset link.\"",
        "Outbox returns exactly one email containing a link matching /reset-password?token=<token>"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-007",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Forgot password with unknown email shows same confirmation and no email",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "nonexistent@testmu.local"
      },
      "steps": [
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email nonexistent@testmu.local into forgot-email",
        "Click forgot-submit",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=nonexistent@testmu.local"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "Element forgot-confirmation contains text \"If an account exists for that email, we've sent a password reset link.\"",
        "Outbox returns an empty list (no email sent)"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-008",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Reset password with valid token updates password and redirects to login notice",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into forgot-email",
        "Click forgot-submit",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=admin@testmu.local"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "admin@testmu.local",
        "new_password": "NewPass123",
        "confirm_password": "NewPass123",
        "token": "<extracted-from-outbox>"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Extract token from the reset email",
        "GET /reset-password?token=<token>",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into reset-password",
        "Enter confirmation NewPass123 into reset-confirm-password",
        "Click reset-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 302 redirect to /login?reason=reset",
        "Element login-notice contains text \"Your password has been updated. Please sign in.\"",
        "Subsequent login with email admin@testmu.local and password NewPass123 succeeds (HTTP 303 to /dashboard)"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": "Token extraction step is performed via test outbox API."
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-009",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Reset password fails when new password is shorter than 8 characters",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local into forgot-email",
        "Click forgot-submit",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=viewer@testmu.local"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "token": "<extracted-from-outbox>",
        "new_password": "short",
        "confirm_password": "short"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Extract token from the reset email",
        "GET /reset-password?token=<token>",
        "Enter new password short into reset-password",
        "Enter confirmation short into reset-confirm-password",
        "Click reset-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 422 response",
        "Element reset-error contains text \"Password must be at least 8 characters.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-010",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Reset password fails when confirmation does not match",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local into forgot-email",
        "Click forgot-submit",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=viewer@testmu.local"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "token": "<extracted-from-outbox>",
        "new_password": "ValidPass123",
        "confirm_password": "Mismatch123"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Extract token from the reset email",
        "GET /reset-password?token=<token>",
        "Enter new password ValidPass123 into reset-password",
        "Enter confirmation Mismatch123 into reset-confirm-password",
        "Click reset-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 422 response",
        "Element reset-error contains text \"Passwords do not match.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-011",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Reset password with expired token is rejected",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into forgot-email",
        "Click forgot-submit",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=admin@testmu.local",
        "POST /_test/clock {\"advance_seconds\": 1860}"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "token": "<extracted-from-outbox>"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Extract token from the reset email",
        "GET /reset-password?token=<token>"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 400 response",
        "Element reset-error contains text \"This reset link is invalid or has expired.\"",
        "No password reset form is displayed"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-012",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Authenticated user can access dashboard within session TTL",
      "coverage_area": "session expiry",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local into login-email",
        "Enter password {{viewer_password}} into login-password",
        "Click login-submit"
      ],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "GET /dashboard"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 200 response with dashboard page",
        "Element user-role contains text \"viewer\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-013",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Accessing dashboard after session TTL redirects to login with expired notice",
      "coverage_area": "session expiry",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into login-email",
        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into login-password",
        "Click login-submit",
        "POST /_test/clock {\"advance_seconds\": 1801}"
      ],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "GET /dashboard"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 redirect to /login?reason=expired",
        "Element login-notice contains text \"Your session has expired. Please sign in again.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-014",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Dashboard access exactly at session TTL boundary triggers expiration",
      "coverage_area": "session expiry",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local into login-email",
        "Enter password {{viewer_password}} into login-password",
        "Click login-submit",
        "POST /_test/clock {\"advance_seconds\": 1800}"
      ],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "GET /dashboard"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 redirect to /login?reason=expired",
        "Element login-notice contains text \"Your session has expired. Please sign in again.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-015",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Five consecutive failed attempts lock the account with lockout message",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "viewer@testmu.local",
        "wrong_password": "bad1"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Attempt 1: Enter email viewer@testmu.local and password bad1, click login-submit",
        "Attempt 2: Repeat with password bad1",
        "Attempt 3: Repeat with password bad1",
        "Attempt 4: Repeat with password bad1",
        "Attempt 5: Repeat with password bad1"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "Attempts 1‑4: HTTP 401 response with login-error \"Invalid email or password.\"",
        "Attempt 5: HTTP 423 response with login-error \"Your account is locked after too many failed sign‑in attempts. Try again later.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-016",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "During lockout, even correct credentials return lockout error",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "Execute LOGIN-015 to lock the viewer account"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "viewer@testmu.local",
        "password": "{{viewer_password}}"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Enter email viewer@testmu.local and password {{viewer_password}}, click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 423 response with login-error \"Your account is locked after too many failed sign‑in attempts. Try again later.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-017",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "After lockout period expires, successful login works and resets failure count",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset",
        "Execute LOGIN-015 to lock the admin account",
        "POST /_test/clock {\"advance_seconds\": 900}"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "email": "admin@testmu.local",
        "password": "{{admin_password}}"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local and password {{admin_password}}, click login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard",
        "Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session",
        "Failure counter for admin@testmu.local is reset to 0"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-018",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Failed attempts with unknown email do not contribute to lockout counter",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": [
        "POST /_test/reset"
      ],
      "test_data": {
        "known_email": "viewer@testmu.local",
        "wrong_password": "badpw",
        "unknown_email": "ghost@example.com"
      },
      "steps": [
        "Attempt 1: viewer@testmu.local / badpw",
        "Attempt 2: viewer@testmu.local / badpw",
        "Attempt 3: viewer@testmu.local / badpw",
        "Attempt 4: viewer@testmu.local / badpw",
        "Attempt 5: unknown@example.com / any",
        "Attempt 6: unknown@example.com / any",
        "Attempt 7: viewer@testmu.local / badpw"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "Attempts 1‑4: HTTP 401 with generic error",
        "Attempts 5‑6: HTTP 401 with generic error (do not affect lockout counter)",
        "Attempt 7: HTTP 423 with lockout message \"Your account is locked after too many failed sign‑in attempts. Try again later.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    }
  ],
  "coverage_map": {
    "valid login": [
      "LOGIN-001",
      "LOGIN-002"
    ],
    "invalid credentials": [
      "LOGIN-003",
      "LOGIN-004",
      "LOGIN-005"
    ],
    "forgot password": [
      "LOGIN-006",
      "LOGIN-007",
      "LOGIN-008",
      "LOGIN-009",
      "LOGIN-010",
      "LOGIN-011"
    ],
    "session expiry": [
      "LOGIN-012",
      "LOGIN-013",
      "LOGIN-014"
    ],
    "brute-force lockout": [
      "LOGIN-015",
      "LOGIN-016",
      "LOGIN-017",
      "LOGIN-018"
    ]
  },
  "open_questions": [
    "What HTTP status code is used for the successful password‑reset redirect to /login?reason=reset?"
  ]
}
